title: The Saffron Drain Beneath Marketbell
theme: Sewer and undercity route used by smugglers, vermin, and civic saboteurs
hook: Marketbell's public fountain has begun spilling yellow dye and confession notes. The council hires the party to enter the Saffron Drain before the festival crowd riots.
background: An undercity route links dye vats, old drainage tunnels, and a forgotten civic archive. Smugglers used it until a whistleblower hid proof of council corruption inside the waterworks.

layout.notes: Drain route with channel rooms, maintenance branches, and flooded service connections.

rooms.name: Fountain Intake
rooms.readAloud: Iron grates groan under yellow-stained water. Festival music echoes above through drain slits.
rooms.gmNotes: The dye marks anyone who enters openly, making stealth harder with city patrols later.
rooms.treasure: A dropped council seal in the intake muck.
rooms.secrets: The flow pattern points toward the old archive route.
rooms.exits: Drain walk to Room 2, maintenance hatch to Room 3.

rooms.name: Saffron Channel
rooms.readAloud: A narrow walkway follows a fast yellow stream. Painted warning arrows contradict one another.
rooms.gmNotes: Some arrows were changed by smugglers; careful scraping reveals older civic marks.

inhabitants.name: Drain Vermin
inhabitants.tactics: Surge from pipe mouths, retreat into waste channels
inhabitants.morale: Scatter when exposed to strong scent or bright flame
inhabitants.leverage: Can be distracted with festival leftovers

rooms.treasure: A waterproof pouch of smuggler tally sticks.
rooms.secrets: A false arrow points toward a vermin nest instead of the archive.
rooms.exits: Back to Room 1, culvert to Room 4.

rooms.name: Pumpkeeper's Nook
rooms.readAloud: A tiny brick room holds rusted valves, tea tins, and a cot tucked above the damp floor.
rooms.gmNotes: The retired pumpkeeper is hiding here and wants the truth public, but fears losing their pension.

inhabitants.name: Retired Pumpkeeper
inhabitants.tactics: Mislead strangers, lock valves, bargain with maps
inhabitants.wants: The sabotage stopped without being blamed
inhabitants.leverage: Knows the clean route to the archive

rooms.treasure: Valve keys and a clean undercity sketch.
rooms.secrets: One tea tin contains a note from the whistleblower, and a hidden valve crawl leads to Room 5.
rooms.exits: Hatch to Room 1, hidden valve crawl to Room 5.

rooms.name: Smuggler Dock
rooms.readAloud: A flat-bottomed skiff bumps against a hidden dock. Crates of dyed cloth sit above the sewage line.
rooms.gmNotes: The smugglers are not the saboteurs; they want their route back and may trade information.

inhabitants.name: Undercity Smugglers
inhabitants.tactics: Use cover, threaten to cut ropes, flee by skiff
inhabitants.morale: Negotiate if their goods are not seized
inhabitants.wants: A safe route and no council patrols
inhabitants.leverage: They can identify the real saboteur's symbol

rooms.treasure: Fine saffron cloth and a smuggler passphrase.
rooms.secrets: A crate bottom hides a maintenance route to Room 5.
rooms.exits: Culvert to Room 2, skiff tunnel to Room 6, hidden crate route to Room 5.

rooms.name: Valve Maze
rooms.readAloud: Wheels and levers cover the walls. Every turn changes the sound of rushing water nearby.
rooms.gmNotes: Correct valve order lowers water in Room 6; wrong order floods Room 2 for a scene.
rooms.treasure: A brass valve wheel stamped with the old city motto.
rooms.secrets: The motto gives the correct valve order: service, truth, water, bread.
rooms.exits: Hidden valve crawl to Room 3, hidden crate route to Room 4, overflow to Room 6.

rooms.name: Old Civic Archive
rooms.readAloud: Stone shelves rise from knee-deep water. Waxed packets float like drowned envelopes.
rooms.gmNotes: The whistleblower hid proof here, but a hired saboteur is burning packets in a dry alcove.

inhabitants.name: Hired Civic Saboteur
inhabitants.tactics: Start fires, kick evidence into water, escape through smoke
inhabitants.morale: Runs if their employer is named aloud
inhabitants.wants: Destroy the proof and collect payment
inhabitants.leverage: Afraid the smugglers will reveal their route

rooms.treasure: Proof of corruption, a whistleblower reward, and old city charter copies.
rooms.secrets: The confession notes are true but were released by the saboteur to create panic.
rooms.exits: Skiff tunnel to Room 4, overflow to Room 5, old stairs to the council cellar.

environmental.result: A slick ledge forces careful crossing
A valve knocks in a four-part rhythm
An old civic motto appears under grime

complications.result: The skiff drifts away unless secured
Smugglers mistake the party for council agents

treasureTable.result: Proof of corruption and reward claim

gmNotes: Keep the city above present through sound and pressure.
The smugglers are useful complications, not the core villains.
The twist is that the confession notes are true and weaponized.
The ending reward is evidence, civic leverage, and festival peace.
